# Prodigy Education

> > Prodigy Education provides game-based learning platforms (Prodigy Math and Prodigy English) with curriculum-aligned content, teacher tools, and educational resources for elementary students.

Prodigy Education offers free educational games aligned with Common Core standards, serving teachers, parents, and students across the United States and Canada. The platform includes assessment tools, differentiated instruction features, classroom activities, and comprehensive teaching resources for grades 1-8.

## Key Topics

- Prodigy Math
- Prodigy English
- game-based learning
- Common Core alignment
- elementary math education
- differentiated instruction
- student assessment and engagement
- classroom activities
- teaching strategies
- place value and decimal concepts
- reading comprehension
- teacher resources and professional development
- parent guides for homeschooling
- problem-based learning

## Teacher Platform & Features

- [Master features](https://prodigygame.com/main-en/teachers/master-features): Prodigy teacher features: assignments, auto-grading, and performance insights
- [Resources | Prodigy Education](https://prodigygame.com/main-en/resources): Free teacher guides, student worksheets, and professional development resources
- [Teachers LP M](https://prodigygame.com/main-en/teachers-lp-m): Teacher landing page for Prodigy Math & English game-based learning tools

## Math Teaching Strategies & Activities

- [Fun Place Value Chart [+ Teaching Tips and 8 Activities]](https://prodigygame.com/main-en/blog/place-value-chart): Printable place value chart with 8 teaching activities for decimals & more
- [A Parent's Guide to Decimal Place Value: Building Your Child's Math Confidence](https://prodigygame.com/main-en/blog/decimal-place-value): Parent guide to teaching decimal place value and building math confidence
- [How to Improve Math Test Scores](https://prodigygame.com/main-en/blog/how-to-improve-math-test-scores): Strategies using Prodigy Math to improve student math test scores
- [15 Addition Activities For Fun And Effective Learning | Prodigy Education](https://prodigygame.com/main-en/blog/addition-activities): 15 hands-on addition activities for elementary math learning
- [Geometry for Kids: A Simple Guide To Get Parents and Teachers Started](https://prodigygame.com/main-en/blog/geometry-for-kids-a-simple-guide): Simple geometry guide teaching shapes and spatial reasoning to kids
- [1st Grade Math Worksheets | Prodigy](https://prodigygame.com/main-en/resources/math-worksheets/first-grade): Common Core-aligned printable math worksheets for first grade students

## Classroom Instruction & Pedagogy

- [5 Advantages and Disadvantages of Problem-Based Learning  [+ Activity Design Steps]](https://prodigygame.com/main-en/blog/advantages-disadvantages-problem-based-learning): Problem-based learning guide with pros, cons, and activity design steps
- [How to Use the 6 Co-Teaching Models to Boost Your Classroom Instruction](https://prodigygame.com/main-en/blog/co-teaching-models): 6 co-teaching models with pros, cons, and instructional strategies
